title: Exact finite-image distance lower bound
assumptions: rho is a homomorphism, so the 14 moves act on the image pair exactly as on words
a word path projects to an image path of the same length
maximum over primes is a valid lower bound; the sum is not
output_meaning: Maximum over primes of the exact distance-to-goal in the finite image pair-graph. An exact lower bound on remaining ordinary AC moves; admissible as an A* heuristic.
limits: Weak: eccentricity is 8/9/11 for p=5/7/11 while observed word paths run 30-70 moves. Not a proven search policy; used as a greedy rank it wanders (REPORT_ACC s7).
